capabilities: list memory notes with keyword search and filters by project, harness, currency, and tag
show a provenance panel for the active memory note
render a d3-force memory graph colored by project and sized by importance
badge and dim superseded and expired memories
group the graph by project, harness, or tag via facet hub nodes
disambiguation: Not the memory engine itself; recall lives in the agentcairn CLI/MCP, and this plugin is only the read/navigate layer.
extras: The plugin is explicitly read-only and local-only: it reads frontmatter via metadataCache, never note bodies, writes nothing, and makes no network requests. Points to a design spec in the main repo for further details.
motivation: The README doesn't state the author's motivation.
problem: Agent memory stored as Markdown notes shows no provenance, importance, or currency status, and superseded memories look identical to current ones.

relations.evidence: This plugin is the read/navigate layer; agentcairn's CLI/MCP is the recall layer.

summary: Read-only Memory view that browses an agentcairn agent-memory vault as a filterable list and an interactive memory graph.
